shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductList.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/Recommendations.tsx && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '940,970p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && sed -n '1598,1632p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && git diff -- package.json next.config.ts app"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git diff --stat && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc 'build_trash=$(mktemp -d /tmp/next-build-output.XXXXXX) && mv /workspace/.next "$build_trash/.next" && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
